_comment: Whole, non-streamed OpenAI chat answers and what a binding's reader makes of them: the sibling of openai-stream-lines.json under the same rules (CON288, owner decision D8 of 2026-11-21).
events: body is the HTTP body as text; text and thinking are the message's content and its reasoning under either name; finish is the raw finish_reason; usage is [prompt_tokens, completion_tokens], or null unless both are whole, non-negative numbers. Any non-null error fails the answer, as in the stream file, and so does a body that is not a JSON object; errors match as substrings

cases.name: an answer with its finish and usage
a finish reason beyond stop and length keeps its raw value
usage with total_tokens, reasoning_tokens and a whole-number float
a negative count is missing, and so is the usage
an OpenAI error object fails the answer
an error object without a message fails with its JSON text
a body that is not an object fails the answer
a body that is no JSON fails the answer
